Load order! Make sure all the WTT weapons load BEFORE Realism

comments.author: Therkelsen
comments.body_html:
Please make sure that the SPT Realism mod loads AFTER all your gun mods!
Otherwise there’s a chance the patches don’t get applied at all.

This can be achieved using the order.json. Example:

{ “order”: [ “1WTT-Armory-Remington ACR”, “WTT-Armory-Ak5C”, “WTT-Armory-XM8”, “WTT-M700 Long Action Lapua”, “WTT-M700 Long Action Norma”, “SPT-Realism” ] }
